info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Enterprise Service Corporate Billing-spec
info.description: The Corporate Billing Management API empowers businesses to efficiently manage corporate billing services within their enterprise applications. This API facilitates the creation and configuration of billing accounts, ensuring accurate invoicing and payment tracking for corporate clients. Typical consumers include financial analysts and systems integrators seeking to automate billing processes and enhance financial reporting. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their billing workflows and improve overall financial operations.

post.description: This operation allows you to create a new corporate billing entry for enterprise services. Ensure all necessary details are provided in the request body to process the billing effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update corporate billing information for enterprises. The payload should contain all necessary billing details in JSON format, adhering to the schema defined for corporate billing operations.
